BEGIN
  IF COALESCE((EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM physical_recovery_intent i WHERE i.pod_uuid = OLD.uuid AND i.phase = 'PREPARED')),0) = 1 THEN

BEGIN
  IF COALESCE(((
    OLD.phase = 'PREPARED' AND NEW.phase = 'COMMITTED'
      AND NEW.pod_uuid = OLD.pod_uuid AND NEW.attempt_uuid = OLD.attempt_uuid
      AND NEW.binding_uuid = OLD.binding_uuid AND NEW.origin = OLD.origin
      AND NEW.source_kind <=> OLD.source_kind AND NEW.source_identity <=> OLD.source_identity
      AND NEW.catalog_generation <=> OLD.catalog_generation AND NEW.create_operation_uuid <=> OLD.create_operation_uuid
      AND NEW.prepared_domain_version = OLD.prepared_domain_version
      AND NEW.target_world_name = OLD.target_world_name
      AND NEW.target_pos_x = OLD.target_pos_x AND NEW.target_pos_y = OLD.target_pos_y AND NEW.target_pos_z = OLD.target_pos_z
      AND NEW.target_yaw = OLD.target_yaw AND NEW.target_pitch = OLD.target_pitch
      AND NEW.target_dimension_id = OLD.target_dimension_id
      AND NEW.target_chunk_x = OLD.target_chunk_x AND NEW.target_chunk_z = OLD.target_chunk_z
      AND EXISTS (
        SELECT 1 FROM floating_pod_state s
        JOIN physical_recovery_locator l ON l.pod_uuid = s.uuid
        WHERE s.uuid = OLD.pod_uuid AND s.owner_uuid IS NULL AND s.state_version = NEW.committed_domain_version
          AND s.is_active = 1 AND s.operating_mode = 'WORLD_IDLE' AND s.dimension_id = NEW.committed_dimension_id
          AND s.world_name = NEW.committed_world_name
          AND s.pos_x = NEW.committed_pos_x AND s.pos_y = NEW.committed_pos_y AND s.pos_z = NEW.committed_pos_z
          AND s.yaw = NEW.committed_yaw AND s.pitch = NEW.committed_pitch AND s.last_updated = NEW.committed_at
          AND l.attempt_uuid = OLD.attempt_uuid AND l.locator_state = 'ROW_ACTIVE' AND l.reason_code = 'row_active'
          AND l.domain_version = NEW.committed_domain_version AND l.target_dimension_id = NEW.committed_dimension_id
      )
      AND NEW.committed_domain_version = OLD.prepared_domain_version + 1
      AND NEW.committed_world_name = OLD.target_world_name
      AND NEW.committed_pos_x = OLD.target_pos_x AND NEW.committed_pos_y = OLD.target_pos_y AND NEW.committed_pos_z = OLD.target_pos_z
      AND NEW.committed_yaw = OLD.target_yaw AND NEW.committed_pitch = OLD.target_pitch
      AND NEW.committed_dimension_id = OLD.target_dimension_id
      AND (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM physical_recovery_locator_chunk c WHERE c.pod_uuid = OLD.pod_uuid) = 25
      AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM physical_recovery_locator_chunk c WHERE c.pod_uuid = OLD.pod_uuid
        AND (c.dimension_id <> OLD.target_dimension_id OR c.chunk_x < OLD.target_chunk_x - 2 OR c.chunk_x > OLD.target_chunk_x + 2
          OR c.chunk_z < OLD.target_chunk_z - 2 OR c.chunk_z > OLD.target_chunk_z + 2))
  )),0) = 0 THEN
    SIGNAL SQLSTATE '45000' SET MESSAGE_TEXT = 'unbound intent only permits exact committed readback';
  END IF;
END

      SELECT 1 FROM floating_pod_state s
      JOIN physical_recovery_binding b ON b.binding_uuid = NEW.binding_uuid AND b.cutover_state = 'CERTIFIED'
      WHERE s.uuid = NEW.pod_uuid AND s.owner_uuid IS NULL AND s.state_version = 0
        AND s.world_name = NEW.target_world_name
        AND s.pos_x = NEW.target_pos_x AND s.pos_y = NEW.target_pos_y AND s.pos_z = NEW.target_pos_z
        AND s.yaw = NEW.target_yaw AND s.pitch = NEW.target_pitch
        AND s.is_active = 0 AND s.dimension_id = NEW.target_dimension_id AND s.operating_mode = 'WORLD_IDLE'
    )),0) = 1 THEN
    SIGNAL SQLSTATE '45000' SET MESSAGE_TEXT = 'unbound intent requires an exact inactive WORLD_IDLE row and certified binding';
  END IF;
  IF COALESCE((EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM physical_recovery_locator WHERE pod_uuid = NEW.pod_uuid)),0) = 1 THEN
    SIGNAL SQLSTATE '45000' SET MESSAGE_TEXT = 'unbound intent cannot replace physical recovery history';
  END IF;
END

BEGIN

      AND NEW.chunk_z BETWEEN i.target_chunk_z - 2 AND i.target_chunk_z + 2
  )),0) = 1 THEN
    SIGNAL SQLSTATE '45000' SET MESSAGE_TEXT = 'unbound prepared locator chunks must match the target square';

  END IF;

BEGIN

      AND i.phase = 'PREPARED' AND i.prepared_domain_version = NEW.domain_version
      AND i.target_dimension_id = NEW.target_dimension_id
      AND s.owner_uuid IS NULL AND s.state_version = NEW.domain_version
      AND s.is_active = 0 AND s.dimension_id = NEW.target_dimension_id
      AND ((i.origin = 'UNBOUND_ADOPTION' AND NEW.locator_state = 'UNBOUND_ADOPTION_PREPARED' AND NEW.reason_code = 'unbound_adoption_prepared')

  END IF;

BEGIN
  -- RS01 HEADER: cardinality exactly1. USER() is connected caller, CURRENT_USER() is definer.
  SELECT @@server_uuid AS server_uuid, @@version AS server_version,
    CONNECTION_ID() AS connection_id, CURRENT_USER() AS audit_definer,
    USER() AS connected_caller, CURRENT_ROLE() AS effective_roles,
    DATABASE() AS routine_default_schema, UTC_TIMESTAMP(6) AS observed_db_time,
    'fp_aud04_base' AS audited_schema,
    m.singleton_fixed1, m.backend, m.format_version, m.ddl_sha256, m.provisioning_uuid,
    m.bootstrap_state, m.expected_server_uuid, m.expected_binding_uuid,
    m.import_state, m.import_operation_uuid, m.import_manifest_sha256,
    m.import_snapshot_sha256, m.import_receipt_sha256, m.guard_manifest_sha256
  FROM `fp_aud04_base`.`fp_schema_manifest` AS m WHERE m.singleton_fixed1=1;

  -- RS02 TABLES: complete fixed-schema set, unexpected tables/views are visible and rejected.
  -- Approximate row counts/timestamps/cardinality are not static-definition identity.
  SELECT TABLE_SCHEMA, TABLE_NAME, TABLE_TYPE, ENGINE, VERSION, ROW_FORMAT,
    TABLE_COLLATION, CREATE_OPTIONS, TABLE_COMMENT
  FROM INFORMATION_SCHEMA.TABLES
  WHERE CAST(TABLE_SCHEMA AS BINARY)=CAST('fp_aud04_base' AS BINARY)
  ORDER BY CAST(TABLE_NAME AS BINARY);

  -- RS03 COLUMNS: full column definitions, including generated expression and exact collation.
  SELECT TABLE_SCHEMA, TABLE_NAME, COLUMN_NAME, ORDINAL_POSITION, COLUMN_DEFAULT,
    IS_NULLABLE, DATA_TYPE, CHARACTER_MAXIMUM_LENGTH, CHARACTER_OCTET_LENGTH,
    NUMERIC_PRECISION, NUMERIC_SCALE, DATETIME_PRECISION, CHARACTER_SET_NAME,
    COLLATION_NAME, COLUMN_TYPE, COLUMN_KEY, EXTRA, COLUMN_COMMENT, GENERATION_EXPRESSION
  FROM INFORMATION_SCHEMA.COLUMNS
  WHERE CAST(TABLE_SCHEMA AS BINARY)=CAST('fp_aud04_base' AS BINARY)
  ORDER BY CAST(TABLE_NAME AS BINARY), ORDINAL_POSITION;

  -- RS04 STATISTICS: complete index key parts; no approximate CARDINALITY in identity.
  SELECT TABLE_SCHEMA, TABLE_NAME, NON_UNIQUE, INDEX_SCHEMA, INDEX_NAME,
    SEQ_IN_INDEX, COLUMN_NAME, COLLATION, SUB_PART, PACKED, NULLABLE,
    INDEX_TYPE, COMMENT, INDEX_COMMENT, IS_VISIBLE, EXPRESSION
  FROM INFORMATION_SCHEMA.STATISTICS
  WHERE CAST(TABLE_SCHEMA AS BINARY)=CAST('fp_aud04_base' AS BINARY)
  ORDER BY CAST(TABLE_NAME AS BINARY), CAST(INDEX_NAME AS BINARY), SEQ_IN_INDEX;

  -- RS05 TABLE_CONSTRAINTS: PK/unique/FK/CHECK identities and CHECK enforcement.
  SELECT CONSTRAINT_CATALOG, CONSTRAINT_SCHEMA, CONSTRAINT_NAME,
    TABLE_SCHEMA, TABLE_NAME, CONSTRAINT_TYPE, ENFORCED
  FROM INFORMATION_SCHEMA.TABLE_CONSTRAINTS
  WHERE CAST(TABLE_SCHEMA AS BINARY)=CAST('fp_aud04_base' AS BINARY)
  ORDER BY CAST(TABLE_NAME AS BINARY), CAST(CONSTRAINT_NAME AS BINARY), CONSTRAINT_TYPE;

  -- RS06 KEY_COLUMN_USAGE: complete ordered constrained/referenced column tuples.
  SELECT CONSTRAINT_CATALOG, CONSTRAINT_SCHEMA, CONSTRAINT_NAME, TABLE_CATALOG,
    TABLE_SCHEMA, TABLE_NAME, COLUMN_NAME, ORDINAL_POSITION, POSITION_IN_UNIQUE_CONSTRAINT,
    REFERENCED_TABLE_SCHEMA, REFERENCED_TABLE_NAME, REFERENCED_COLUMN_NAME
  FROM INFORMATION_SCHEMA.KEY_COLUMN_USAGE
  WHERE CAST(TABLE_SCHEMA AS BINARY)=CAST('fp_aud04_base' AS BINARY)
  ORDER BY CAST(TABLE_NAME AS BINARY), CAST(CONSTRAINT_NAME AS BINARY), ORDINAL_POSITION;

  -- RS07 REFERENTIAL_CONSTRAINTS: exact parent key and referential actions.
  SELECT CONSTRAINT_CATALOG, CONSTRAINT_SCHEMA, CONSTRAINT_NAME,
    UNIQUE_CONSTRAINT_CATALOG, UNIQUE_CONSTRAINT_SCHEMA, UNIQUE_CONSTRAINT_NAME,
    MATCH_OPTION, UPDATE_RULE, DELETE_RULE, TABLE_NAME, REFERENCED_TABLE_NAME
  FROM INFORMATION_SCHEMA.REFERENTIAL_CONSTRAINTS
  WHERE CAST(CONSTRAINT_SCHEMA AS BINARY)=CAST('fp_aud04_base' AS BINARY)
  ORDER BY CAST(TABLE_NAME AS BINARY), CAST(CONSTRAINT_NAME AS BINARY);

  -- RS08 CHECK_CONSTRAINTS: full expressions, not just names/counts.
  SELECT CONSTRAINT_CATALOG, CONSTRAINT_SCHEMA, CONSTRAINT_NAME, CHECK_CLAUSE,
    OCTET_LENGTH(CHECK_CLAUSE) AS clause_octets,
    UNHEX(SHA2(CAST(CHECK_CLAUSE AS BINARY),256)) AS clause_sha256
  FROM INFORMATION_SCHEMA.CHECK_CONSTRAINTS
  WHERE CAST(CONSTRAINT_SCHEMA AS BINARY)=CAST('fp_aud04_base' AS BINARY)
  ORDER BY CAST(CONSTRAINT_NAME AS BINARY);

  -- RS09 TRIGGERS: whole schema, not expected-name IN filtering that hides extra objects.
  SELECT TRIGGER_SCHEMA, TRIGGER_NAME, EVENT_OBJECT_SCHEMA, EVENT_OBJECT_TABLE,
    EVENT_MANIPULATION, ACTION_TIMING, ACTION_ORDER, ACTION_ORIENTATION,
    ACTION_STATEMENT, SQL_MODE, DEFINER, CHARACTER_SET_CLIENT,
    COLLATION_CONNECTION, DATABASE_COLLATION,
    OCTET_LENGTH(ACTION_STATEMENT) AS statement_octets,
    UNHEX(SHA2(CAST(ACTION_STATEMENT AS BINARY),256)) AS statement_sha256
  FROM INFORMATION_SCHEMA.TRIGGERS
  WHERE CAST(TRIGGER_SCHEMA AS BINARY)=CAST('fp_aud04_base' AS BINARY)
  ORDER BY CAST(TRIGGER_NAME AS BINARY);

  -- RS10 required auditself only: exactly one complete definition/security/definer row.
  -- ROUTINE_DEFINITION NULL is failure; READS label is not proof that body is read-only.
  SELECT ROUTINE_SCHEMA, ROUTINE_NAME, ROUTINE_TYPE, ROUTINE_DEFINITION,
    SECURITY_TYPE, SQL_DATA_ACCESS, SQL_MODE, DEFINER, CHARACTER_SET_CLIENT,
    COLLATION_CONNECTION, DATABASE_COLLATION, IS_DETERMINISTIC,
    DATA_TYPE, DTD_IDENTIFIER, ROUTINE_COMMENT,
    OCTET_LENGTH(ROUTINE_DEFINITION) AS definition_octets,
    UNHEX(SHA2(CAST(ROUTINE_DEFINITION AS BINARY),256)) AS definition_sha256
  FROM INFORMATION_SCHEMA.ROUTINES
  WHERE CAST(ROUTINE_SCHEMA AS BINARY)=CAST('fp_aud04_base' AS BINARY)
    AND CAST(ROUTINE_NAME AS BINARY)=CAST('fp_audit_schema_format1' AS BINARY)
    AND ROUTINE_TYPE='PROCEDURE'
  ORDER BY CAST(ROUTINE_NAME AS BINARY), ROUTINE_TYPE;

  -- RS11 required auditself parameters only: zero rows with singleton RS10 proves no arguments.
  SELECT SPECIFIC_CATALOG, SPECIFIC_SCHEMA, SPECIFIC_NAME, ORDINAL_POSITION,
    PARAMETER_MODE, PARAMETER_NAME, DATA_TYPE, DTD_IDENTIFIER,
    CHARACTER_SET_NAME, COLLATION_NAME
  FROM INFORMATION_SCHEMA.PARAMETERS
  WHERE CAST(SPECIFIC_SCHEMA AS BINARY)=CAST('fp_aud04_base' AS BINARY)
    AND CAST(SPECIFIC_NAME AS BINARY)=CAST('fp_audit_schema_format1' AS BINARY)
  ORDER BY CAST(SPECIFIC_NAME AS BINARY), ORDINAL_POSITION;

  -- RS12 BINDING: current scope only, no certification mutation or new identity.
  SELECT singleton_fixed1, binding_uuid, cutover_state, format_version
  FROM `fp_aud04_base`.`physical_recovery_binding` ORDER BY singleton_fixed1;

  -- RS13 WRITER: DB server UUID is not game boot UUID. Receipt values are metadata identity.
  SELECT singleton_fixed1, binding_uuid, writer_epoch, owner_boot_uuid,
    lease_until, last_commit_operation_uuid, last_commit_fingerprint
  FROM `fp_aud04_base`.`fp_runtime_writer` ORDER BY singleton_fixed1;

  -- RS14 FOOTER: must match RS01 entire persisted manifest/instance/schema/identity tuple.
  -- observed_db_time may advance; all stored identities and security/caller context must remain exact.
  SELECT @@server_uuid AS server_uuid, @@version AS server_version,
    CONNECTION_ID() AS connection_id, CURRENT_USER() AS audit_definer,
    USER() AS connected_caller, CURRENT_ROLE() AS effective_roles,
    DATABASE() AS routine_default_schema, UTC_TIMESTAMP(6) AS observed_db_time,
    'fp_aud04_base' AS audited_schema,
    m.singleton_fixed1, m.backend, m.format_version, m.ddl_sha256, m.provisioning_uuid,
    m.bootstrap_state, m.expected_server_uuid, m.expected_binding_uuid,
    m.import_state, m.import_operation_uuid, m.import_manifest_sha256,
    m.import_snapshot_sha256, m.import_receipt_sha256, m.guard_manifest_sha256
  FROM `fp_aud04_base`.`fp_schema_manifest` AS m WHERE m.singleton_fixed1=1;
END
